core_obligations: Short exactness on injectives (proof lines 7194-7205): for an injective abelian sheaf the sequence of section complexes of X, U, V and the intersection is short exact, because the higher cohomology of the restrictions of an injective sheaf vanishes.

Long exact sequence (proof lines 7205-7220): resolving an arbitrary sheaf injectively, the short exact sequence of complexes gives the displayed long exact cohomology sequence, functorially in the sheaf.
proof_roadmap: Check the short exactness of the section complexes for an injective sheaf.
Resolve an arbitrary sheaf injectively to reduce to that case.
Take the long exact sequence of the resulting short exact sequence of complexes.
difficulty_reason: The lemma produces the Mayer-Vietoris long exact sequence of etale cohomology for a scheme which is the union of two open subschemes (statement lines 7175-7192, whose bracketed naming of the sequence is part of the environment and is delivered verbatim). The proof verifies the short exactness of the section complexes in the case of an injective sheaf, using that the higher cohomology of the restrictions of an injective sheaf vanishes (proof lines 7194-7205), and then resolves an arbitrary sheaf injectively, which yields the displayed long exact sequence (proof lines 7205-7220). The non-formal content is the identification of the relevant cohomology with the cohomology of the complexes in question. The claim is H2: one short-exactness check plus one resolution argument.
